THE PROBLEM

Why it matters

Calculators built with eval() can run injected code.

HOW IT WAS BUILT

Approach

Tokenizer + grammar functions, each rule calling the next level of precedence. Fully unit-tested.

Key features

  • 01Operator precedence and parentheses
  • 02Functions and constants
  • 03History
  • 04Safe by design
